content: {"reasoning":"The requested CO-16 document has already been provided, and there is no current payer response supporting another information submission or an appeal. Authorization is on file, claim data are valid, and resubmitting without confirming adjudication risks an unnecessary duplicate; the remaining deductible alone does not establish an adjudicated patient balance. Because no available action can properly advance the claim without its current status, a specialist should verify adjudication and any patient responsibility.","action":"escalate"}
